:::{#def-basin-of-attraction}
#### Basin of attraction

For given [step lengths](#def-gradient-descent),
the **basin of attraction** of a
[local minimizer](algebra-basics.qmd#def-local-minimizer) $\vx^*$
under [gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent)
is the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) of starting points $\iterpoint{\vx}{0}$
from which the [iterates](#def-iterate)
[converge](#def-vector-sequence-limit) to $\vx^*$
[@wikipedia_attractor].

:::
